notes.detail: API dev watcher restarted while new imported source/layout files were being authored. Initial layout/browser starts received ECONNREFUSED. One competing watcher briefly reported EADDRINUSE; final verification waits for healthy 127.0.0.1:4310.
Adjusted the direct browser script to use existing field groups: managed Host in Options, browser Delivery in General and Served by in Connections. No product implementation change was needed.

Grocery external-client affected-object link correctly selects its existing C1 context binding. Changed the verification locator to use the actual canonical studioTarget, instead of assuming every linked element opens C2.
One default-inspection launch used the shell Node 18 and was rejected by Playwright before page load; final required observations use the explicit Node 24 bin path.
Initial lint reported five formatting errors in newly captured JSON evidence. Format only scoped evidence before final lint; existing warning/info counts remain the comparison.
